remarks: Distinctive architecture and a contemporary loft-like feel define this Santa Monica corner townhome, offering only one shared wall within an intimate 10-unit complex. Thoughtfully arranged across multiple levels, this 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath residence features ensuite bathrooms in every bedroom, providing privacy and flexibility for everyday living. Soaring ceilings, expansive windows, skylights, and clean architectural lines create an airy, light-filled setting that feels both modern and welcoming.
